scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic and all-size. Finite computations independently check small instances and randomly selected larger ones; computations do not certify the unrestricted statements or historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Synchronous binary Rule 90 on finite cyclic rings with fixed noiseless sensors. Rank formula and placement census apply to observations at times zero through n minus one; sharp minimal horizon proved only for successful pairs. Historical priority needs external validation; Plenet et al. (2022) was examined from its public abstract only.
title: Exact rank deficits and optimal static sensors for cyclic Rule 90
